params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$runner = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner-heaven'
$startup=Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'HeavenGitHubActionsRunner.vbs'
$diagFiles=@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runner '_diag') -Filter 'Runner_*.log' -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 3)
$diag=@()
foreach($f in $diagFiles){
  $tail=(Get-Content -LiteralPath $f.FullName -Tail 140 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "
"
  $interesting=($tail -split "
" | Where-Object { $_ -match '(?i)(error|warn|fail|session|broker|message|job|offline|connect|retry|429|403|404|acquir|request)' } | Select-Object -Last 50) -join "
"
  $diag += [ordered]@{name=$f.Name; modified=$f.LastWriteTimeUtc.ToString('o'); interesting=$interesting}
}
[ordered]@{
  startup_fallback_exists = Test-Path $startup
  diagnostics = $diag
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 7
